maria-ops: Hi finance team, the corp card failed at the hotel check-in in Dublin so I paid A3145.60 on my personal card. The hotel charged the corp card later for the parking only (A320). I uploaded the folio. Need reimbursement for A31125.60.

 tom-sales: Was this during a customer site visit? Please add customer name and attendees.

 maria-ops: Yes, customer: BrightCore Ltd. Attendees: Maria O (Redwood), Tom S (Redwood), Liam B (BrightCore).

 katie-finance: Thanks. We need: 1) folio upload (got it), 2) brief business purpose: "Onsite kickoff with BrightCore", 3) proof of corp card decline (a refund or decline message) if available. If no decline message, note "terminal declined; personal card used to complete check-in". Also note currency conversion preference (we reimburse in USD using card-posted rate).

 dan-corpcard: I see the corp card has a failed authorization on 2026-04-11 at 14:02 from the hotel vendor. Attach the screenshot of the failed swipe from Ramp portal if you have it. Ramp will reimburse personal charges per posted amount.

 expensebot: ExpenseBot: Auto-parse folio: Room A3100.00; Parking A320.00; Taxes & fees A315.60; Total A3145.60. Flag: split between corp posted (parking A320) and personal (A31125.60). Missing: "business purpose" field.

 maria-ops: Added business purpose: "Onsite kickoff with BrightCore to review integration scoping". Uploading Ramp screenshot of the failed authorization now.

 katie-finance: Great. Submit under expense type "Travel - Lodging" and code GL 6102. We will reimburse A31125.60 converted to USD using the Maria's bank posted rate; please attach the posted USD amount screenshot to avoid manual FX. If you can't, finance will use XE rate on transaction date.

 tom-sales: Thx all. Maria, ping me if you need manager note for exceptions.

 expensebot: ExpenseBot: Reminder: submit within 30 days to avoid additional review.
